figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 1. Overview of the MEP pathway, experimental tools, and key findings related to IPPI’s influence on isomer-specific isoprenoid
incorporation. (A) The MEP pathway in B. subtilis produces IPP and DMAPP. (B) Structures of isomer-specific IPP and DMAPP metabolites. (C)
Cell-permeant SIE-IPP and SIE-DMAPP analogs, developed in previous work, were used in this study to deliver prenyl precursors. (D) Tracking
the independent functions of IPP and DMAPP is complicated by IPPI-mediated isomerization activity. (E) The synthesis of stable isotope labeled
[3,4,5-13C3] self-immolating ester-protected DMAPP (13C3 SIE-DMAPP) enables isomer-specific tracking of DMAPP in B. subtilis. (F) The growth
of B. subtilis on either IPP or DMAPP depends on IPPI activity. (G) Isomer-specific tracking is achieved using B. subtilis Δfni, and complete
isoprenoid isotopic labeling from DMAPP alone is facilitated by IPPI overexpression.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2. Tracking MK-7 biosynthesis in the presence of 13C3 SIE-
DMAPP. (A) Structure of
13C3 SIE-DMAPP, which undergoes
hydrolysis by native esterases to release 13C3 DMAPP. (B) DMAPP
serves as the starter unit for prenyl diphosphate synthesis. Sequential
addition of IPP by farnesyl pyrophosphate synthase (FPPS) and
heptaprenyl pyrophosphate synthase (HepS) generates the heptap-
renyl pyrophosphate side chain. DMAPP is isomerized to IPP by
IPPI, contributing labeled extender units. The hepPP chain is then
condensed with 1,4-dihydroxy-2-naphthoic acid (DHNA) by MenA
to form MK-7. The pattern of 13C3 incorporation into MK-7 varies
with IPPI activity, as shown for Δfni, WT, and OE::fni strains. Red
stars denote 13C3 labeled positions; gray stars indicate additional
possible labels due to IPPI-mediated isomerization.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 3. MK-7 enables tracking of 13C3 DMAPP in B. subtilis WT.
(A) The area of the EICs for each specified label (m/z) is presented
as a percentage relative to the total MK-7 in B. subtilis WT. (B−D)
The m/z ratios of MK-7 isolated from the following experimental
conditions: (B) B. subtilis WT fed SIE-IPP and SIE-DMAPP; (C) B.
subtilis WT fed with SIE-IPP and 13C3 SIE-DMAPP; (D) B. subtilis
WT fed with SIE-IPP and 13C3 SIE-DMAPP during coadministration
with fosmidomycin, n = 3. Data represents mean ± standard deviation
(SD).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 4. DMAPP specific incorporation of 13C3 DMAPP of B. subtilis
Δfni. (A) The area of the EICs for each specified label (m/z) is
presented as a percentage relative to the total MK-7 in B. subtilis Δfni.
(B) The m/z ratios of MK-7 isolated from B. subtilis Δfni fed with
SIE-IPP and
13C3 SIE-DMAPP during coadministration with
fosmidomycin, n = 3. Data represents mean ± SD.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 5
figure_candidates.caption: Figure 5. Overview of the experimental design to monitor the 10 h growth of B. subtilis in a 96-well format.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 6
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 6. The growth of B. subtilis under genetic inhibition of the
MEP pathway is enabled by SIE-IPP. (A) Area under the curve
relative to the DMSO vehicle control for each concentration of SIE-
IPP tested, with and without induction of dCas. (B−C) Growth
curves of B. subtilis dCas9-ispH in the presence of SIE-IPP without
(B) and with (C) induction of dCas. (D) Area under the curve
relative to the DMSO vehicle control for each concentration of SIE-
DMAPP tested, with and without induction of dCas, n = 3. Data
represents mean ± SD.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 7
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 7. Matrix-based growth rescue assay with increasing
concentrations of SIE-DMAPP (vertical axis) and SIE-IPP (horizontal
axis) coincubated with fosmidomycin. The color gradient indicates
the area under the growth curve relative to the control for (A) B.
subtilis WT, (B) B. subtilis Δfni, and (C) B. subtilis OE::fni, n = 2.
Data represents mean.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 8
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 8. Growth with 13C3-DMAPP enables complete isoprenoid
isotopic labeling. (A) Structure and exact [M + H]+ masses of MK-7
and fully 13C3 labeled MK-7 (B) EICs area for each specified label as a
percentage of total MK-7 in B. subtilis OE::fni fed with 25 μM SIE-
IPP and 10 μM 13C3 SIE-DMAPP (C−D) The m/z ratios of MK-7
isolated from B. subtilis OE::fni fed with SIE-IPP and (C) 13C3 SIE-
DMAPP or (D)
13C3 SIE-DMAPP during coadministration with
fosmidomycin. (E) EICs area for each specified label as a percentage
of total MK-7 in B. subtilis OE::fni fed 50 μM 13C3 SIE-DMAPP. (F)
The m/z ratios of MK-7 isolated from B. subtilis OE::fni fed with 50
μM 13C3 SIE-DMAPP during coadministration with fosmidomycin, n
= 3. Data represents mean ± SD.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 9
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 9. Sporulation with 13C3 SIE-DMAPP allows for tracking MK-
7 in both the mother cell and endospore of sporulating B. subtilis. (A)
The area of the EICs for each specified label (m/z) is presented as a
percentage relative to the total MK-7 in B. subtilis Δfni fed with 13C3
SIE-DMAPP during sporulation in the mother cell only. (B) The m/z
of MK-7 isolated from the mother cell of B. subtilis Δfni during
sporulation fed with 13C3 SIE-DMAPP during coadministration with
fosmidomycin. (C) The area of the EICs for each specified label (m/
z) is presented as a percentage relative to the total MK-7 in B. subtilis
Δfni fed with 13C3 SIE-DMAPP during sporulation in the endospore
only. (D) M/Z ratios of MK-7 isolated from the endospore of B.
subtilis Δfni during sporulation fed with 13C3 SIE-DMAPP during
coadministration with fosmidomycin. Data represent mean ± SD (n =
3 for 12C controls; n = 6 for 13C3 labeled samples). A Wilcoxon rank-
sum test comparing
13C3 labeled MK-7 from mother cells vs
endospores yields p = 0.005.
